summary: Granola's internal API splits newer surfaces across per-service *.api.granola.ai shard hostnames and gates requests on a current desktop X-Client-Version; regens must preserve shard-aware routing and re-verify the desktop client version.
reason: Static discovery against Granola desktop 7.867.0 (app.asar) and live read-only probes confirmed that endpoints such as get-people (pecan), get-pre-meeting-briefs (maple), get-follow-up-emails (berry), get-mcp-agents (cinnamon), and list-available-integrations (chia) live on dedicated subdomains and accept X-Granola-Workspace-Id scoping. Hardcoding a single api.granola.ai host or an older client version drops these live surfaces.
validated_outcome: Live read-only verification against Granola desktop 7.867.0 returned HTTP 200 across all 10 added endpoints on api, pecan, maple, berry, cinnamon, and chia shards; unit tests cover shard routing, X-Client-Version, X-Granola-Workspace-Id, dry-run, and local-mode guards.
